args.reason: The supersession argument is sound. The old decision rested on its own stated premise (fewer than 20 issues per run, simplicity), which no longer holds: runs now admit 200+ issues and the concurrency executor writes many issues in parallel. The new design addresses two concrete failure modes the old one did not anticipate, lock contention and a single corrupt byte losing the whole run, while keeping the same directory root and adding an index file for discovery. The rationale follows from changed facts, not preference.
